_note: Owner-approved compartment answers for the sofa lines still on a bare -1S placeholder on PROCEEDED company-1 orders, 2026-09-04. Same shape as sofa-compartment-corrections-2026-08.json. Every entry names the documents it applies to, the model, the target piece list, the seat where the book or the slip states one, the desc2Match that tells one build on a document from another, and a why recording how the answer was reached. Four entries are the owner's own reading, given in chat; the rest are read off the photograph and confirmed by him. 2026-09-08: HC-SO-013475 was added to this same file rather than a new one - a fourth file whose name also contains "2026-09" would make the FILE= substring filter select two rounds at once (scripts/lib/sofa-corrections-source.test.mjs pins that), and this build carries its own why, which is where the evidence has to live. It is NOT a placeholder build: it is the shop floor reporting that the drawing and our decode disagree. 2026-09-08 ROUND 2: 16 more builds, all of them the owner's OWN words given in chat while he read his slips one by one. They are appended to THIS file rather than a new one for the reason the previous sentence gives - a fourth file whose name also contains "2026-09" would make the FILE= substring filter select two rounds at once, which scripts/lib/sofa-corrections-source.test.mjs pins. Two of them (HC-SO-012827) are matched on the account book's own LINE KEY rather than on text, because the book wrote one line's Desc2 as a substring of the other's and no needle can tell them apart. 2026-09-08 ROUND 3: the TWO builds round 2 deliberately held are now written, and `_held` is EMPTY. Each was held for a real reason and each reason is gone, because he gave the missing word himself. HC-SO-011601 had only its corner and its seat; the rest of the slip was read off the 240px original enlarged 4x, put to him, and confirmed 「对啊」. HC-SO-011657 was held because 9838-STOOL is not minted and nobody held the judgement of which model a `TNS-9838 DB` stool belongs to; he answered 「那就放8030 daybed把」. An answered build may not sit in `_held`: the operator's log prints held builds as outstanding work and makeSofaRulingLookup excludes them, so parking an answer there keeps handing him back a question he has already settled (docs/bugs/0720). HC-SO-011657 is also the first entry to carry `modelOverride` - the ERP names a product the book does not, by his decision, and the declaration is what lets the grader tell that from the hand-typed model of docs/bugs/0693.
_rules: Money never moves: the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0. Lines are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place so a row id - and any purchase allocation hanging off it - survives. A document can hold MORE THAN ONE sofa build, so desc2Match is required; where a document holds TWO lines with the SAME text those are two identical sofas and both take the build.
